# Alpha diversity
## ASV (observed richness, rarefied)
```{r, eval = F}
# rarefy to even depth (minimum sample size)
set.seed(1)
ps_rare <- rarefy_even_depth(
  ps_nonorm,
  sample.size = min(sample_sums(ps_nonorm)),
  rngseed     = 42,
  replace     = FALSE,
  trimOTUs    = TRUE,
  verbose     = TRUE
)

# observed richness per sample
alpha <- data.frame(
  observed = estimate_richness(ps_rare, measures = "Observed")$Observed,
  metadata
)

# mean and SD per site x layer
means <- alpha %>%
  group_by(code, layer) %>%
  summarise(mean = mean(observed),
            sd   = sd(observed),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(layer)

# plot richness by layer and site
ggplot(means, aes(x = layer, y = mean, group = code)) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = mean - sd, ymax = mean + sd),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.5),
    width    = 0.25,
    color    = "black") +
  geom_point(position = position_dodge(width = 0.5), size = 2.5,
            aes(color = code)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = colors_site) +
  labs(
    y     = "Observed richness (ASV)",
    x     = "Layer",
    color = "Site") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 8) +
  theme(
    axis.title.x    = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x     = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    legend.title    = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "none")

#ggsave("plots/richness_asv.pdf", width = 10, height = 7.5, units = "cm")

# linear mixed model (log-transformed richness)
model_lmm <- lmer(log(observed) ~ site * layer + (1|qpit), data = alpha)
anova_summary <- broom.mixed::tidy(anova(model_lmm, type = 3))
anova_summary

# model assumptions
shapiro.test(residuals(model_lmm))
plot(model_lmm)
qqnorm(residuals(model_lmm))
qqline(residuals(model_lmm))
leveneTest(log(observed) ~ site * layer, data = alpha)

# post hoc tests (main effects only)
emm_layer <- emmeans(model_lmm, specs = pairwise ~ layer)
emm_site <- emmeans(model_lmm, pairwise ~ site,
                    at = list(layer = c("Ol0", "Ol1", "Olf", "Ohf", "A5", "A10")))

# extract contrasts
res_layer <- as.data.frame(emm_layer$contrasts)
res_site  <- as.data.frame(emm_site$contrasts)

# mean and SD per layer
means_layer <- alpha %>%
  group_by(layer) %>%
  summarise(mean_observed = mean(observed),
            sd_observed   = sd(observed),
            .groups = "drop")

# collect results for export
results_for_excel_asv <- list(
  "LMM_ANOVA_Summary"         = anova_summary,
  "PostHoc_Layer_Main"        = res_layer,
  "PostHoc_Site_within_Layer" = res_site,
  "Means_Raw_Layer"           = means_layer
)

#write_xlsx(results_for_excel, path = "stats/alpha_diversity_lmm_asv.xlsx")
```

## Phylum (observed, rarefied)
```{r, eval = F}
# rarefy to even depth (minimum sample size)
set.seed(1)
ps_rare <- rarefy_even_depth(
  ps_nonorm,
  sample.size = min(sample_sums(ps_nonorm)),
  rngseed     = 42,
  replace     = FALSE,
  trimOTUs    = TRUE,
  verbose     = TRUE
)

# agglomerate to phylum level and compute richness
ps_phylum <- tax_glom(ps_rare, taxrank = "Phylum")
alpha_phy <- data.frame(
  "observed" = estimate_richness(ps_phylum, measures = "Observed")$Observed,
  data.frame(sample_data(ps_phylum)))

# mean and SD per site x layer
means_phy <- alpha_phy %>%
  group_by(code, layer) %>%
  summarise(mean = mean(observed),
            sd   = sd(observed),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(layer)

# plot richness by layer and site
ggplot(means_phy, aes(x = layer, y = mean, group = code)) +
  geom_errorbar(

    position = position_dodge(width = 0.5),
    width    = 0.25,
    color    = "black"
  ) +

            aes(color = code)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = colors_site) +

    y     = "Observed Richness (Phylum)",
    x     = "Layer",
    color = "Site"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 8) +
  theme(
    axis.title.x    = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x     = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),

#ggsave("plots/richness_phylum.pdf", width = 10, height = 7.5, units = "cm")

anova_summary

# model assumptions

# post hoc tests (main effects only)

# extract contrasts

res_site  <- as.data.frame(emm_site$contrasts)
```

## data export
```{r, eval = F}
# combine ANOVA tables
anova_combined <- bind_rows(
  results_for_excel_asv$LMM_ANOVA_Summary %>% mutate(Index = "ASV richness"),
  results_for_excel_phylum$LMM_ANOVA_Summary %>% mutate(Index = "Phylum richness")
) %>%
  select(Index, Effect = term, SumSq = sumsq, MeanSq = meansq,
         NumDF, DenDF, F_value = statistic, p_value = p.value) %>%
  mutate(p_value = ifelse(p_value < 0.0001, "<0.0001",
                          formatC(p_value, format = "f", digits = 4)))

# combine layer post-hoc tables
posthoc_layer_combined <- bind_rows(
  results_for_excel_asv$PostHoc_Layer_Main %>% mutate(Index = "ASV richness"),
  results_for_excel_phylum$PostHoc_Layer_Main %>% mutate(Index = "Phylum richness")
) %>%
  select(Index, Contrast = contrast, Estimate = estimate, SE, df,
         t_ratio = t.ratio, p_value = p.value) %>%
  mutate(p_value = ifelse(is.na(p_value), "not estimable",
                          ifelse(p_value < 0.0001, "<0.0001",
                                 formatC(p_value, format = "f", digits = 4))))

# combine site post-hoc tables
posthoc_site_combined <- bind_rows(
  results_for_excel_asv$PostHoc_Site_within_Layer %>% mutate(Index = "ASV richness"),
  results_for_excel_phylum$PostHoc_Site_within_Layer %>% mutate(Index = "Phylum richness")
) %>%
  select(Index, Contrast = contrast, Estimate = estimate, SE, df,
         t_ratio = t.ratio, p_value = p.value) %>%
  mutate(p_value = ifelse(p_value < 0.0001, "<0.0001",
                          formatC(p_value, format = "f", digits = 4)))

# sheet overview / descriptions
overview <- data.frame(
  Sheet = c("ANOVA", "PostHoc_Layer", "PostHoc_Site"),
  Description = c(
    "Type III ANOVA results from linear mixed-effects models on log-transformed richness data (Satterthwaite's method) for ASV and phylum richness",
    "Tukey-adjusted pairwise comparisons between soil layers, averaged over sites. 'not estimable' indicates comparisons involving the Oh horizon, which was not sampled at Bad Brückenau",
    "Tukey-adjusted pairwise comparisons between sites, averaged over the six layers present at all sites (Oh excluded)"  )
)

# combine and write to file
results_supplement <- list(
  "Overview"      = overview,
  "ANOVA"         = anova_combined,
  "PostHoc_Layer" = posthoc_layer_combined,
  "PostHoc_Site"  = posthoc_site_combined
)

write_xlsx(results_supplement, path = "stats/alpha_diversity.xlsx")
```

# Composition on phylum level
```{r, eval = F}
# agglomerate to phylum level and compute relative abundance per sample
ps_aggregate <- tax_glom(ps, taxrank = "Phylum")
ps_melted <- psmelt(ps_aggregate) %>%
  group_by(Sample) %>%
  mutate(RelativeAbundance = Abundance / sum(Abundance, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup()

# mean relative abundance per site, layer, and phylum
summary_data <- ps_melted %>%
  group_by(code, layer, Phylum) %>%
  summarise(AverageAbundance = mean(RelativeAbundance, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop")

# top 12 phyla by cumulative mean abundance
top_phyla <- summary_data %>%
  group_by(Phylum) %>%
  summarise(TotalAbundance = sum(AverageAbundance, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  arrange(desc(TotalAbundance)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 12) %>%
  pull(Phylum)

# coverage check: community fraction captured by the top phyla
mean_coverage <- ps_melted %>%
  mutate(IsTop = Phylum %in% top_phyla) %>%
  group_by(Sample, IsTop) %>%
  summarise(SumAbundance = sum(RelativeAbundance, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(IsTop) %>%
  pull(SumAbundance) %>%
  mean()

message(sprintf("Top %d phyla cover %.1f%% of the community on average.",
                length(top_phyla), mean_coverage * 100))

# prepare plot data with ordered layer factor
plot_data <- summary_data %>%
  filter(Phylum %in% top_phyla) %>%
  mutate(layer = factor(layer,
                        levels = c("Ol0", "Ol1", "Olf", "Ohf", "Oh", "A5", "A10")))

# colour palette for phyla
color_palette <- c(
  "#0072B2", "lightcoral", "#E69F00", "#FAD391", "#FF8C4D", "#CC79A7",
  "#56B4E9", "#D55E00", "#78D2B7", "#009E73", "#F0E442", "#E09FD2",
  "#117733", "#8C564B", "#5D3A9B"
)

# per-site facet strip colours
site_strip_colors <- c(BBR = "#D55E00", MIT = "#009E73", KAN = "#0072B2")
site_strip_list   <- lapply(site_strip_colors, function(col) {
  element_rect(fill = col, color = "black", linewidth = 0.2)
})

# stacked area plot of phylum composition
ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = layer, y = AverageAbundance,
                      fill = Phylum, group = Phylum)) +
  geom_area() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = color_palette) +
  labs(y = "Relative Abundance") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 8) +
  theme(
    strip.text       = element_text(size = 10),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
    axis.title.x     = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x      = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    legend.title     = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold"),
    legend.position  = "bottom"
  ) +
  facet_wrap2(~ code,
              strip = ggh4x::strip_themed(background_x = site_strip_list))

# ggsave("plots_final/composition_1.pdf", width = 13, height = 10, units = "cm", dpi = 400)


# Supplementary tables: phylum abundances

# format helper: scientific notation for very small values, fixed otherwise
format_nice <- function(x) {
  case_when(
    x == 0        ~ "0",
    abs(x) < 0.01 ~ formatC(x, format = "e", digits = 2),
    TRUE          ~ formatC(x, format = "f", digits = 3)
  )
}

# mean abundance per layer (across sites)
table_layer_overall <- ps_melted %>%
  group_by(layer, Phylum) %>%
  summarise(Mean_Abundance = mean(RelativeAbundance, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(Phylum) %>%
  mutate(Total = sum(Mean_Abundance)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(desc(Total)) %>%
  select(-Total) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = layer, values_from = Mean_Abundance, values_fill = 0) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), format_nice))

# mean abundance per layer and site
table_layer_site <- ps_melted %>%
  group_by(code, layer, Phylum) %>%
  summarise(Mean_Abundance = mean(RelativeAbundance, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  unite("Site_Layer", c(code, layer), sep = "_") %>%
  group_by(Phylum) %>%
  mutate(Total = sum(Mean_Abundance)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(desc(Total)) %>%
  select(-Total) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Site_Layer, values_from = Mean_Abundance, values_fill = 0) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), format_nice))

# collect supplementary tables for export
export_list <- list(
  "Phyla_per_Layer_Overall"  = table_layer_overall,
  "Phyla_per_Layer_and_Site" = table_layer_site
)

# write_xlsx(export_list, path = "stats/phylum_abundances.xlsx")
```

# Beta diversity per layer
```{r, eval = F}
# loop over layers: PERMANOVA, mean between-site distance, beta-dispersion
layers <- unique(metadata$layer)
results_list <- list()
for (cur_layer in layers) {
  # subset to current layer and drop empty taxa
  ps_sub <- subset_samples(ps, layer == cur_layer)
  ps_sub <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(ps_sub) > 0, ps_sub)
  grouping <- sample_data(ps_sub)$code

  # weighted UniFrac distances and group statistics
  dist_mat <- phyloseq::distance(ps_sub, method = "wunifrac")
  perm <- vegan::adonis2(dist_mat ~ grouping)
  md   <- meandist(dist_mat, grouping)
  disp <- vegan::betadisper(dist_mat, grouping)
  disp_values <- disp$distances

  # store one row per site pair
  pair_names <- combn(rownames(md), 2, simplify = FALSE)
  for (p in pair_names) {
    pair_label <- paste(sort(p), collapse = " - ")
    results_list[[paste(cur_layer, pair_label)]] <- data.frame(
      label         = cur_layer,
      pair          = pair_label,
      R2            = perm[1, "R2"],
      Distance      = md[p[1], p[2]],
      Dispersion    = mean(disp_values),
      Dispersion_SE = sd(disp_values) / sqrt(length(disp_values))
    )
  }
}

# reshape to long format and label metrics
plot_data <- bind_rows(results_list) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols      = c(R2, Distance, Dispersion),
    names_to  = "metric_raw",
    values_to = "value"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    SE = case_when(
      metric_raw == "Dispersion" ~ Dispersion_SE,
      TRUE ~ 0
    ),
    metric_label = factor(case_match(metric_raw,
      "R2"         ~ "PERMANOVA R²",
      "Distance"   ~ "Between-Site Distance",
      "Dispersion" ~ "Beta-Dispersion"
    )),
    label = factor(label, levels = c("Ol0", "Ol1", "Olf", "Ohf", "Oh", "A5", "A10"))
  )

# faceted plot: distance per site pair + R2/dispersion trends
ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = label, y = value)) +
  # dispersion error bars
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = value - SE, ymax = value + SE),
    width = 0.1, linewidth = 0.3, color = "black",
    data = subset(plot_data, metric_raw == "Dispersion")
  ) +
  # between-site distance lines per pair
  geom_line(
    aes(group = pair, linetype = pair),
    data = subset(plot_data, metric_raw == "Distance"),
    color = "black", linewidth = 0.5
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = subset(plot_data, metric_raw == "Distance"),
    color = "black", size = 2
  ) +
  scale_linetype_manual(
    values = c("BBR - KAN" = "solid", "BBR - MIT" = "dashed", "KAN - MIT" = "dotted"),
    name = "Site Pair"
  ) +
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = c("BBR - KAN" = 16, "BBR - MIT" = 17, "KAN - MIT" = 15),
    name = "Site Pair"
  ) +
  # R2 and dispersion trend lines
  geom_line(
    aes(group = 1),
    data = subset(plot_data, metric_raw != "Distance"),
    color = "grey60", linewidth = 0.5
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = subset(plot_data, metric_raw != "Distance"),
    size = 2, color = "black"
  ) +
  # pair labels on the first layer only
  geom_label_repel(
    aes(label = pair),
    data = subset(plot_data, metric_raw == "Distance" & label == "Ol0"),
    size = 2, fill = "white",
    label.size = NA, show.legend = FALSE, label.padding = 0.1, segment.color = "grey50"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ metric_label, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(x = NULL) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 8) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x      = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, color = "black"),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black"),
    strip.text       = element_text(size = 7),
    axis.title.y     = element_blank(),
    legend.position  = "none",
  )

ggsave("plots/beta_per_layer.pdf", width = 7, height = 10, units = "cm")
```

# NMDS
```{r, eval = F}
# weighted UniFrac distances
dist_wunifrac <- phyloseq::distance(ps, method = "wunifrac")

# NMDS ordination and stress
nmds_wunifrac <- ordinate(ps, method = "NMDS", distance = dist_wunifrac)
round(nmds_wunifrac$stress, 3)

# extract site scores and join sample metadata
nmds_scores <- as.data.frame(scores(nmds_wunifrac, "sites"))
nmds_scores <- cbind(nmds_scores, data.frame(sample_data(ps)))

# point shapes per layer
shapes_layer <- c(16, 15, 17, 18, 3, 4, 8)

# NMDS plot: colour by site, shape by layer
ggplot(nmds_scores, aes(x = NMDS1, y = NMDS2)) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5, alpha = 1, aes(shape = layer, color = code)) +
  stat_ellipse(aes(group = layer),
               level    = 0.95,
               linetype = "dashed",
               alpha    = 0.4,
               color    = "black") +  
  scale_shape_manual(values = shapes_layer) +
  scale_color_manual(values = colors_site) +
  labs(color = "Site", shape = "Layer") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 8) +

    legend.title    = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )

                                by = "term", strata = metadata$qpit)
permanova_export <- as.data.frame(permanova_res) %>%
```

# 16S GCN
```{r, eval = F}
# extract OTU matrix and matching gene copy number predictions
otu <- as(otu_table(ps), "matrix")
gcn <- read.csv("raw_data/gcn_predictions.csv") %>%
  filter(index %in% row.names(otu)) %>%
  pull(predicted_copy_number)

# correct counts by copy number -> estimated cell counts
otu_corrected <- sweep(otu, 1, gcn, FUN = "/")

# per-sample read totals, cell totals, and average GCN
total_reads_per_sample <- colSums(otu)
total_cells_per_sample <- colSums(otu_corrected)
average_gcn_per_sample  <- total_reads_per_sample / total_cells_per_sample

# weighted SD of GCN per sample (weighted by corrected abundance)
weighted_sd_per_sample <- sapply(1:ncol(otu_corrected), function(i) {
  weights      <- otu_corrected[, i]
  present_asvs <- weights > 0
  sqrt(Hmisc::wtd.var(x = gcn[present_asvs],
                      weights = weights[present_asvs]))
})
names(weighted_sd_per_sample) <- colnames(otu)

# assemble result data frame and join metadata
gcn_df <- data.frame(
  gcn      = average_gcn_per_sample,
  sd_indiv = weighted_sd_per_sample
) %>%
  rownames_to_column("nr") %>%
  left_join(metadata %>% dplyr::select(layer, code, nr, qpit, site), by = "nr")

# mean and SD per layer and site for plotting
gcn_df_plot <- gcn_df %>%
  group_by(layer, code) %>%
  summarise(
    mean = mean(gcn, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd   = sd(gcn, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# plot average GCN by layer and site
ggplot(gcn_df_plot, aes(x = layer, y = mean, color = code, group = code)) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = mean - sd, ymax = mean + sd),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.5),
    width    = 0.25,
    color    = "black"
  ) +
  geom_point(position = position_dodge(width = 0.5), size = 2.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = colors_site) +
  labs(
    y     = "Average GCN",
    color = "Site"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 8) +
  theme(
    axis.title.x    = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x     = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    legend.title    = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

#ggsave("plots/gcn.pdf", width = 7, height = 10, units = "cm", dpi = 600)

# Statistical testing

# check variance homogeneity
gcn_df$group_check <- interaction(gcn_df$layer, gcn_df$site)
leveneTest(gcn ~ group_check, data = gcn_df)

# linear mixed model and Type III ANOVA
model_gcn_lmm <- lmer(gcn ~ code * layer + (1 | qpit), data = gcn_df)
anova_summary <- broom.mixed::tidy(anova(model_gcn_lmm, type = 3))
print(anova_summary)

# post hoc: layer main effect and site within layer
emm_layer       <- emmeans(model_gcn_lmm, specs = pairwise ~ layer, weights = "cells")
emm_interaction <- emmeans(model_gcn_lmm, specs = pairwise ~ code | layer)
res_layer       <- as.data.frame(emm_layer$contrasts)
res_interaction <- as.data.frame(emm_interaction$contrasts)

# mean and SD per layer and per layer x site
means_layer <- gcn_df %>%
  group_by(layer) %>%
  summarise(mean = mean(gcn, na.rm = TRUE),
            sd   = sd(gcn, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop")

means_site_layer <- gcn_df %>%
  group_by(layer, site) %>%
  summarise(mean = mean(gcn, na.rm = TRUE),
            sd   = sd(gcn, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop")

# collect results for export
results_for_excel <- list(
  "LMM_ANOVA_Summary"         = anova_summary,
  "PostHoc_Layer_Main"        = res_layer,
  "PostHoc_Site_within_Layer" = res_interaction,
  "Means_Raw_Site_Layer"      = means_site_layer,
  "Means_Raw_Layer"           = means_layer
)
```

# Indicator genus
```{r, eval = F}
site_levels  <- c("BBR", "MIT", "KAN")
layer_levels <- c("Ol0", "Ol1", "Olf", "Ohf", "Oh", "A5", "A10")

# Aggregation to genus level

# agglomerate to genus and assign unique genus names
ps_genus <- tax_glom(ps, taxrank = "Genus", NArm = TRUE)
taxa_names(ps_genus) <- make.unique(as.character(tax_table(ps_genus)[, "Genus"]))

# relative abundances with ordered site factor
ps_rel <- microbiome::transform(ps_genus, "compositional")
sample_data(ps_rel)$code <- factor(sample_data(ps_rel)$code, levels = site_levels)

# identify core genera per site within each layer
detection_core  <- 0.003
prevalence_core <- 0.8

all_core_genera <- c()

for (current_layer in layer_levels) {
  ps_layer <- subset_samples(ps_rel, layer == current_layer)
  sites    <- unique(as.character(sample_data(ps_layer)$code))

  for (current_code in sites) {
    ps_subset <- subset_samples(ps_layer, code == current_code)
    all_core_genera <- c(all_core_genera,
                        core_members(ps_subset,
                                     detection  = detection_core,
                                     prevalence = prevalence_core))
  }
}

# keep only core genera
ps_filtered <- prune_taxa(unique(all_core_genera), ps_genus)

# indicator species analysis per layer
all_indicators_df <- data.frame()
set.seed(123)

for (current_layer in layer_levels) {
  ps_subset <- subset_samples(ps_filtered, layer == current_layer)

  # genus x sample table and site grouping
  otu_subset    <- otu_table(ps_subset) %>% data.frame() %>% t()
  groups_subset <- factor(sample_data(ps_subset)$code, levels = site_levels)

  # group-equalized indicator value analysis
  indval_res <- multipatt(otu_subset, groups_subset,
                          func    = "IndVal.g",
                          duleg   = TRUE,
                          control = how(nperm = 999))

  # BH-adjusted p-values
  layer_results <- indval_res$sign %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    rownames_to_column("genus") %>%
    mutate(q_value = p.adjust(p.value, method = "BH"))

  # tag with site and layer, then collect
  if (nrow(layer_results) > 0) {
    layer_results <- layer_results %>%
      mutate(
        code  = levels(groups_subset)[index],
        layer = current_layer
      )
    all_indicators_df <- bind_rows(all_indicators_df, layer_results)
  }
}

# top 3 indicators per site x layer
data <- all_indicators_df %>%
  select(genus, stat, p.value, q_value, code, layer) %>%
  filter(p.value <= 0.05) %>%
  group_by(code, layer) %>%
  arrange(desc(stat)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 3) %>%
  ungroup()

# taxonomy lookup with renaming
tax <- tax_table(ps_genus) %>%
  data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("genus") %>%
  select(genus, Genus) %>%
  mutate(Genus = str_replace(Genus,
                            "Burkholderia-Caballeronia-Paraburkholderia",
                            "Burkholderia s.l."))

# join taxonomy and format labels (italic genus names)
data_1 <- left_join(data, tax, by = "genus") %>%
  mutate(
    layer           = factor(layer, levels = layer_levels),
    code            = factor(code,  levels = site_levels),
    Genus_formatted = paste0("<i>", Genus, "</i>")
  )

# mean relative abundance per genus, site, and layer (point size)
abund_data <- psmelt(ps_rel) %>%
  group_by(OTU, code, layer) %>%
  summarise(MeanAbund = mean(Abundance), .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::rename(genus = OTU)

data_sized <- data_1 %>%
  left_join(abund_data, by = c("genus", "code", "layer"))

# plot: indicator value vs genus, faceted by site
ggplot(data_sized, aes(
    y     = reorder_within(Genus_formatted,
                          (-as.numeric(as.factor(layer)) * 1e6) + stat, code),
    x     = stat,
    color = layer,
    size  = MeanAbund
  )) +
  geom_point(shape = 16, alpha = 0.75) +
  scale_y_reordered() +
  scale_size_continuous(
    breaks = c(0.001, 0.005, 0.01, 0.05, 0.1),
    name   = "Rel. Abund.",
    range  = c(0.5, 4),
    labels = scales::percent
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(name = "Layer", values = colors_horizon) +
  facet_wrap(~ code, scales = "free_y", ncol = 1) +
  labs(x = "Indicator Value", y = "Genus") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 8) +
  theme(
    axis.title.y    = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y     = element_markdown(angle = 0, hjust = 1, size = 7),
    axis.text.x     = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5),
    legend.title    = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.box      = "vertical",
    legend.margin   = margin(0, 0, 0, 0)
  ) +
  guides(
    color = guide_legend(order = 1, nrow = 1),
    size  = guide_legend(order = 2, nrow = 1)
  )
```

# RDA per layer
```{r, eval = F}

set.seed(123)

# STEP 1: driver screening per layer

# full predictor set (overwritten by the reduced set below)
all_predictors <- c( "CN", "CP", "Ca_tot", "Al_tot", "K_tot", "Mg_tot",
                              "Mn_tot", "Na_tot", "p_i_citrate", "p_org_citrate", "p_total_citrate",
                              "Fe_tot", "TOC", "P_tot", "pH", "Al_exch", "Ca_exch", "Fe_exch", "K_exch",
                     "Mg_exch", "Mn_exch", "Na_exch")
# reduced predictor set actually used in the screening
all_predictors <- c( "CN", "CP", "p_total_citrate",
                     "pH", "Al_exch", "Ca_exch", "Fe_exch", "K_exch",
                     "Mg_exch", "Mn_exch", "Na_exch")
# all_predictors <- c(
#   "TOC", "N_tot", "P_tot", "CN", "CP", "pH", "KAK", "BS",
#   "Al_tot", "Ca_tot", "Fe_tot", "K_tot", "Mg_tot", "Mn_tot", "Na_tot",
#     "p_i_citrate", "p_org_citrate", "p_total_citrate",
#     "Al_oxal", "Fe_oxal", "Mn_oxal", "P_oxal",
#     "Al_exch", "Ca_exch", "Fe_exch", "K_exch", "Mg_exch", "Mn_exch", "Na_exch", "H_exch"
# )

driver_screening_results <- list()

# screen each layer (skip the first layer)
for (current_layer in layers[2:7]) {

  print(current_layer)
  ps_sub <- subset_samples(ps, layer == current_layer)
  metadata_sub <- sample_data(ps_sub) %>% data.frame()

  current_layer_results_list <- list()

  # test each predictor
  for (predictor in all_predictors) {

        test_data <- metadata_sub %>%
        select(all_of(predictor), site) %>%
        drop_na()

        # does the variable differ by site?
        lm_model <- lm(as.formula(paste(predictor, "~ site")), data = test_data)
        p_val_site <- anova(lm_model)$"Pr(>F)"[1]

        # does the variable impact the microbiome?
        ps_test <- prune_samples(rownames(test_data), ps_sub)
        dist_test <- phyloseq::distance(ps_test, method = "wunifrac")

        model_adonis <- adonis2(as.formula(paste("dist_test ~", predictor)),
                                data = test_data,
                                permutations = 999)
        p_val_microbe <- model_adonis$"Pr(>F)"[1]

        # save per-predictor results
        current_layer_results_list[[predictor]] <- data.frame(
          variable = predictor,
          p_val_site = p_val_site,
          p_val_microbe = p_val_microbe
    )
  }

  # combine, BH-correct, and keep predictors significant on both fronts
  shortlist_drivers <- dplyr::bind_rows(current_layer_results_list) %>%
    mutate(Layer = current_layer) %>%
    mutate(q_val_site = p.adjust(p_val_site, "BH"),
           q_val_microbe = p.adjust(p_val_microbe, "BH")) %>%
    filter(q_val_site < 0.05 & q_val_microbe < 0.05)

  # VIF filtering to drop collinear predictors
  if (nrow(shortlist_drivers) > 1)
    {
    print("going in: ")
    print(paste(shortlist_drivers$variable))
    vif_data <- metadata_sub %>%
      select(all_of(shortlist_drivers$variable)) %>%
      drop_na()
    vif_test <- usdm::vifstep(vif_data, th = 10)

    # final filtering by VIF
    shortlist_drivers <- shortlist_drivers %>%
      filter(variable %in% vif_test@results$Variables)
    print("going out: ")
    print(paste(shortlist_drivers$variable))
   }
  else
    {
    print(current_layer)
    print("<2 drivers, skipping vif")
    }


  # collect final driver list for this layer
  driver_screening_results[[current_layer]] <- shortlist_drivers
  #print(shortlist_drivers)

  rm(test_data, ps_test,
     model_adonis, lm_model,
     current_layer_results_list,
     p_val_microbe,
     p_val_site,
     vif_data, predictor)
}


# STEP 2: dbRDA using those drivers

dbrda_results_list <- list()
dbrda_model_list <- list()
dbrda_margin_results_list <- list()

# per-layer dbRDA
for (current_layer in layers[2:7]) {

  # setup
  ps_sub <- subset_samples(ps, layer == current_layer)
  metadata_sub <- sample_data(ps_sub) %>% data.frame()

  # drivers selected for this layer
  layer_drivers <- driver_screening_results[[current_layer]]$variable

  # skip dbRDA if there are no drivers
  if (length(layer_drivers) == 0) {
    print("No significant drivers found. Skipping dbRDA.")
    next
  }

  # complete-case env data for the RDA
  env_data_rda <- metadata_sub %>%
    select(all_of(layer_drivers)) %>%
    drop_na()
  # distance matrix matching the complete-case samples
  dist_rda <- phyloseq::distance(prune_samples(rownames(env_data_rda), ps_sub),
                                   method = "wunifrac")

  # build formula dynamically from drivers
  model_formula <- as.formula(paste("dist_rda ~", paste(layer_drivers, collapse = " + ")))
  # fit dbRDA
  model_dbrda <- dbrda(model_formula, data = env_data_rda)

  # adjusted R squared
  r2_adj <- RsquareAdj(model_dbrda)$adj.r.squared

  # overall model significance
  model_anova <- anova.cca(model_dbrda, permutations = 999)
  p_value <- model_anova$"Pr(>F)"[1]

  # save overall results
  dbrda_results_list[[current_layer]] <- data.frame(
    Layer = current_layer,
    Adj_R_Squared = r2_adj,
    P_Value = p_value,
    Model_Formula = paste(layer_drivers, collapse = " + ")
  )

  # marginal (by-term) significance
  model_anova_terms <- anova.cca(model_dbrda, by = "margin", permutations = 999)
  # save term-level results
  if (nrow(model_anova_terms) > 0) {
      term_results_df <- as.data.frame(model_anova_terms)
      term_results_df$variable <- rownames(term_results_df)
      term_results_df$layer <- current_layer
      term_results_df <- term_results_df %>% filter(variable != "Residual")
      dbrda_margin_results_list[[current_layer]] <- term_results_df
    }

  # store fitted model
  dbrda_model_list[[current_layer]] <- model_dbrda


}

# combine across layers
dbrda_results <- dplyr::bind_rows(dbrda_results_list)
dbrda_margin_results <- dplyr::bind_rows(dbrda_margin_results_list)

# clean up workspace
rm(dbrda_results_list, current_layer, layer_drivers, dist_test, driver_screening_results, env_data_rda, all_predictors, dbrda_margin_results_list, term_results_df, model_anova, model_anova_terms, vif_test, shortlist_drivers, metadata_sub, model_dbrda, ps_sub, model_formula, p_value, r2_adj, dist_rda)


# summarise drivers retained per layer
final_drivers_summary <- dbrda_margin_results %>%
  # keep only layer and driver name
  dplyr::select(layer, variable) %>%
  group_by(layer) %>%
  # collapse all drivers into one string
  summarise(
    N_Drivers = n(),
    Drivers_Used = paste(variable, collapse = "; "),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::rename(Layer = layer)

# overall model results (adjusted R2)
dbrda_results_clean <- dbrda_results %>%
  dplyr::select(Layer, Adj_R_Squared, P_Value) %>%
  # round for clean output
  mutate(
    Adj_R_Squared = round(Adj_R_Squared, 3),
    P_Value = round(P_Value, 3)
  )

# marginal term analysis (contribution of each variable)
dbrda_margin_results_clean <- dbrda_margin_results %>%
  # the column is named 'Rsquare', not 'R2'
  dplyr::select(layer, variable, Rsquare, F, `Pr(>F)`) %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    Layer = layer,
    Term = variable,
    R2 = Rsquare,
    P_Value = `Pr(>F)`
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    R2 = round(R2, 3),
    F = round(F, 3),
    P_Value = round(P_Value, 3)
  )

# collect all results for export
results_for_excel_rda <- list(
  "Overall_Model_R2" = dbrda_results_clean,
  "Significant_Drivers_Summary" = final_drivers_summary,
  "Marginal_Term_Analysis" = dbrda_margin_results_clean
)

#write_xlsx(results_for_excel_rda, path = "stats/dbrda_analysis_simple.xlsx")
```

# global RDA
```{r, eval = F}
set.seed(123)

# data preparation

# candidate predictors
all_predictors <- c("CN", "CP", "p_total_citrate", "pH",
                    "Al_exch", "Ca_exch", "Fe_exch", "K_exch",
                    "Mg_exch", "Mn_exch", "Na_exch")

# subset phyloseq (exclude Ol0)
ps_sub <- subset_samples(ps, layer != "Ol0")

# extract metadata, drop NAs, z-standardize predictors
env_data <- sample_data(ps_sub) %>%
  data.frame() %>%
  dplyr::select(all_of(all_predictors)) %>%
  na.omit() %>%
  scale() %>%
  as.data.frame()

# match phyloseq samples to complete-case metadata
complete_samples <- rownames(env_data)
ps_run           <- prune_samples(complete_samples, ps_sub)

# weighted UniFrac distance matrix
dist_wunifrac <- phyloseq::distance(ps_run, method = "wunifrac")



# model selection

# null model (intercept only) and full model (all predictors)
dbrda_null <- dbrda(dist_wunifrac ~ 1, data = env_data)
dbrda_full <- dbrda(dist_wunifrac ~ ., data = env_data)

# forward selection with double stopping criterion (p-value + adj. R2)
dbrda_final <- ordiR2step(dbrda_null,
                          scope        = formula(dbrda_full),
                          direction    = "forward",
                          permutations = 999,
                          trace        = 0)

print("Selected model:")
print(dbrda_final$call)



# statistics

# A) overall model fit 
r2_adj_overall <- RsquareAdj(dbrda_final)$adj.r.squared
anova_overall  <- anova.cca(dbrda_final, permutations = 999)
p_val_overall  <- anova_overall$`Pr(>F)`[1]

print(paste0("RESULT FOR TEXT: The final model explains ",
             round(r2_adj_overall * 100, 1), "% of variance (adj. R2) with p = ",
             p_val_overall))

# B) marginal effects per variable 
anova_marginal <- anova.cca(dbrda_final, by = "margin", permutations = 999)

# total inertia 
total_inertia <- dbrda_final$tot.chi

stats_marginal <- as.data.frame(anova_marginal) %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "Variable") %>%
  filter(Variable != "Residual") %>%
  mutate(
    Var_Explained_Pct = (SumOfSqs / total_inertia) * 100,
    SumOfSqs          = round(SumOfSqs, 3),
    F_Value           = round(F, 3),
    P_Value           = round(`Pr(>F)`, 3),
    Var_Explained_Pct = round(Var_Explained_Pct, 1)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(Variable, SumOfSqs, Var_Explained_Pct, F_Value, P_Value)

# overall ANOVA table for export
stats_overall <- as.data.frame(anova_overall) %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "Term")

# export to Excel
output_list <- list(
  "Overall_Model_Stats"  = stats_overall,
  "Marginal_Drivers_S16" = stats_marginal
)

#write_xlsx(output_list, path = "stats/dbrda_global_analysis.xlsx")


# plotting

# site scores + metadata for aesthetics
site_scores <- as.data.frame(scores(dbrda_final, display = "sites"))
meta_plot   <- data.frame(sample_data(ps_run))
site_scores <- cbind(site_scores, meta_plot[rownames(site_scores), ])

# biplot scores (predictor arrows)
arrow_scores <- as.data.frame(scores(dbrda_final, display = "bp"))
arrow_scale  <- 0.5

# axis labels: % of total inertia explained by dbRDA1 / dbRDA2
eig       <- dbrda_final$CCA$eig
var_axis1 <- round((eig[1] / sum(dbrda_final$tot.chi)) * 100, 1)
var_axis2 <- round((eig[2] / sum(dbrda_final$tot.chi)) * 100, 1)

# ordination plot with site points and predictor arrows
ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = site_scores,
             aes(x = dbRDA1, y = dbRDA2, color = layer, shape = site),
             size = 3) +
  geom_segment(data = arrow_scores,
               aes(x = 0, y = 0,
                   xend = dbRDA1 * arrow_scale, yend = dbRDA2 * arrow_scale),
               arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.25, "cm")),
               color = "black", alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_text_repel(data = arrow_scores,
                  aes(x = dbRDA1 * arrow_scale, y = dbRDA2 * arrow_scale,
                      label = rownames(arrow_scores)),
                  box.padding = 0.5, point.padding = 0.3,
                  segment.color = "grey50") +
  labs(x     = paste0("dbRDA1 (", var_axis1, "%)"),
       y     = paste0("dbRDA2 (", var_axis2, "%)"),
       color = "Layer",
       shape = "Site") +
  scale_color_manual(values = colors_horizon[-1]) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  coord_fixed() +
  guides(color = guide_legend(nrow = 1), shape = guide_legend(nrow = 1)) +
  theme(
    legend.box = "vertical"
  )

#ggsave("plots/Global_dbRDA.pdf", width = 15, height = 16, units = "cm")
```

# Cores
```{r, eval = F}

# agglomerate to genus 
ps_genus <- tax_glom(ps, taxrank = "Genus", NArm = TRUE)

taxa_names(ps_genus) <- as.character(tax_table(ps_genus)[, "Genus"])
ps_genus <- subset_taxa(ps_genus, !grepl(" G\\.$", taxa_names(ps_genus)))

ps_genus_rel <- microbiome::transform(ps_genus, "compositional")

# core parameters
detection_core <- 0.01
prevalence_core <- 0.8

sample_data(ps_genus_rel)$code <- as.character(sample_data(ps_genus_rel)$code)
cores <- setNames(vector("list", length(layers)), layers)

# shared core across sites within each layer
for (current_layer in layers) {
  ps_layer_only <- subset_samples(ps_genus_rel, layer == current_layer)
  sites_in_this_layer <- unique(sample_data(ps_layer_only)$code)
  venn_list <- list()
  for (current_site in sites_in_this_layer) {

    ps_subset <- subset_samples(ps_layer_only, code == current_site)
        venn_list[[current_site]] <- core_members(ps_subset,
                                              detection = detection_core,
                                              prevalence = prevalence_core)
  }

  # core = intersection of cores
  cores[[current_layer]] <- Reduce(intersect, venn_list)
}

print(cores)
# save(cores, file = "r_objects/core_microbiomes_genus.RData")


# core read abundance
#load("r_objects/core_microbiomes_genus.RData")
print("READ COVERAGE BY CORE TAXA:")

# mean read coverage of core taxa per layer
for (current_layer in names(cores)) {
  core_taxa_names <- cores[[current_layer]]
    ps_layer <- subset_samples(ps_genus_rel, layer == current_layer)
    ps_core_only <- prune_taxa(core_taxa_names, ps_layer)
    coverage_per_sample <- sample_sums(ps_core_only)
    mean_cov <- mean(coverage_per_sample) * 100
    sd_cov   <- sd(coverage_per_sample) * 100
    cat(sprintf("Layer %s: core (%d genera) covers on average %.2f%% (+/- %.2f%%) of reads.\n",
                current_layer, length(core_taxa_names), mean_cov, sd_cov))

}
```

## cores heatmap
```{r, eval = F}
# load("r_objects/core_microbiomes_genus_per_layer.RData")

# order taxa
test <- cores[[1]]
ps_OL0 <- subset_samples(ps_genus, layer == layers[1]) 
ps_OL0_rel <- microbiome::transform(ps_OL0, "compositional")
ps_OL0_pr <- prune_taxa(test, ps_OL0_rel)

# sort by total abundance
test2 <- taxa_sums(ps_OL0_pr) %>%
  tibble::enframe(name = "TaxonID", value = "Sum") %>%
  arrange(desc(Sum)) %>%
  pull(TaxonID)
cores[[1]] <- test2


# prepare data for the heatmap
cores_total <- na.omit(Reduce(union, cores))

# prune to core taxa and convert to relative abundance
ps_sub <- prune_taxa(cores_total, ps_genus)
ps_sub <- microbiome::transform(ps_sub, "compositional")

otu_matrix <- otu_table(ps_sub) %>% data.frame()
metadata <- data.frame(sample_data(ps_sub)) 


# average abundances per site and layer
avg_otu_matrix <- otu_matrix %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "taxon") %>%
  pivot_longer(-taxon, names_to = "nr", values_to = "abundance") %>%
  mutate(nr = str_remove(nr, "^X")) %>%
  left_join(
    metadata %>% select(nr, code, site, layer), by = "nr"
  ) %>%
  group_by(taxon, layer, code) %>%
  summarise(mean_abundance = mean(abundance), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = c(layer, code), values_from = mean_abundance, names_sep = "_") %>%
  column_to_rownames(var = "taxon") %>%
  as.matrix()


# column metadata
column_meta_avg <- data.frame(col_name = colnames(avg_otu_matrix)) %>%
  separate(col_name, into = c("layer", "site"), sep = "_", remove = FALSE)

column_meta_avg$layer <- factor(column_meta_avg$layer, levels = layers)
column_meta_avg <- column_meta_avg %>% arrange(layer, site)

# reorder matrix by taxa and ordered columns
avg_otu_matrix <- avg_otu_matrix[cores_total, column_meta_avg$col_name]


# core membership matrix
core_membership_matrix <- sapply(cores, function(core_taxa) {
  as.integer(cores_total %in% core_taxa)
})
rownames(core_membership_matrix) <- cores_total
colnames(core_membership_matrix) <- names(cores)
```

## cores abundance
```{r, eval = F}

# initialize results table
core_summary_table <- tibble()

for (current_layer in names(cores)) {

  ps_layer <- subset_samples(ps_genus_rel, layer == current_layer)
  # keep only genera present in this layer (sum > 0)
  ps_layer <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(ps_layer) > 0, ps_layer)
  # genus counts (number and percentage)
  core_taxa_names <- cores[[current_layer]]
  n_core_genera   <- length(core_taxa_names)
  n_total_genera  <- ntaxa(ps_layer)
  perc_genera     <- (n_core_genera / n_total_genera) * 100

  # read coverage (mean)
  ps_core_only   <- prune_taxa(core_taxa_names, ps_layer)
  cov_per_sample <- sample_sums(ps_core_only)

  mean_read_cov <- mean(cov_per_sample) * 100
  sd_read_cov   <- sd(cov_per_sample) * 100

  # append to table
  core_summary_table <- bind_rows(core_summary_table, tibble(
    Layer = current_layer,
    n_Genera_Core = n_core_genera,
    n_Genera_Total = n_total_genera,
    Pct_Genera_Core = perc_genera,
    Pct_Reads_Core_Mean = mean_read_cov,
    Pct_Reads_Core_SD = sd_read_cov
  ))
}

# round for cleaner output
final_table <- core_summary_table %>%
  mutate(across(starts_with("Pct"), ~ round(., 2)))
```

# outlier identification
```{r, eval = F}

# PCoA 
ps_rel <- transform_sample_counts(ps_nonorm, function(x) x / sum(x))
pcoa   <- ordinate(ps_rel, method = "PCoA", distance = "bray")

# data prep: extract scores and flag the suspected outlier pit
pcoa_df <- data.frame(pcoa$vectors[, 1:2]) %>%
  bind_cols(data.frame(sample_data(ps_rel))) %>%
  mutate(Status = ifelse(qpit == "KAN.1", "Outlier", "Retained"),
         Label = ifelse(qpit == "KAN.1", as.character(layer), NA_character_))

# global centroid and per-pit distance to it
global_cent <- colMeans(pcoa$vectors[, 1:2])
dist_df <- pcoa_df %>%
  group_by(qpit) %>%
  summarise(Axis1 = mean(Axis.1), Axis2 = mean(Axis.2), .groups = "drop") %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    Dist = sqrt((Axis1 - global_cent[1])^2 + (Axis2 - global_cent[2])^2),
    Color = ifelse(qpit == "KAN.1", "red", "grey20")
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Dist))

# plotting

# PCoA ordination, outlier highlighted
p1 <- ggplot(pcoa_df, aes(Axis.1, Axis.2, color = Status, shape = Status)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("red", "grey20")) +
  labs(x = "PCoA 1", y = "PCoA 2") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
  geom_text_repel(
    aes(label = Label),
    size = 3,
    min.segment.length = 0,
    box.padding = 0.5,
    max.overlaps = Inf,
    show.legend = FALSE
  )

# per-pit distance to global centroid
p2 <- ggplot(dist_df, aes(x = reorder(qpit, -Dist), y = Dist, fill = Color)) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_identity() +
  labs(x = "Quantitative Pit", y = "Distance to Centroid") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 8) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "bottom")

# combine panels
ggarrange(p1, p2, widths = c(2, 1.5))

#ggsave("plots_final/S2_Outlier_Check.pdf", p1 + p2, width = 20, height = 10, units = "cm")
```

# alpha diversity ASV and phylum (Shannon & Pielou)
```{r, eval = F}
# rarefy to even depth (minimum sample size)
set.seed(1)
ps_rare <- rarefy_even_depth(
  ps_nonorm,
  sample.size = min(sample_sums(ps_nonorm)),
  rngseed     = 42,
  replace     = FALSE,
  trimOTUs    = TRUE,
  verbose     = TRUE
)

# helper: extract alpha indices + sample data
get_alpha <- function(ps) {
  data.frame(
    shannon = estimate_richness(ps, measures = "Shannon")$Shannon,
    pielou  = evenness(ps, index = "pielou")$pielou,
    data.frame(sample_data(ps))
  )
}

# helper: summarise per code x layer
summarise_alpha <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    group_by(code, layer) %>%
    summarise(
      mean_shannon = mean(shannon),
      sd_shannon   = sd(shannon),
      mean_pielou  = mean(pielou),
      sd_pielou    = sd(pielou),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(layer)
}

# helper: plot mean +/- SD by layer and site
plot_alpha <- function(df, y_mean, y_sd, ylab) {
  ggplot(df, aes(x = layer, y = .data[[y_mean]], group = code)) +
    geom_errorbar(
      aes(ymin = .data[[y_mean]] - .data[[y_sd]],
          ymax = .data[[y_mean]] + .data[[y_sd]]),
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.5),
      width = 0.25, color = "black"
    ) +
    geom_point(position = position_dodge(width = 0.5),
               size = 2.5, aes(color = code)) +
    scale_color_manual(values = colors_site) +
    labs(y = ylab, x = "Layer", color = "Site") +
    theme_bw(base_size = 8) +
    theme(
      axis.title.x = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold"),
      legend.position = "none"
    )
}

# ASV level
alpha_asv  <- get_alpha(ps_rare)
means_asv  <- summarise_alpha(alpha_asv)

# phylum level
ps_phylum  <- tax_glom(ps_rare, taxrank = "Phylum")
alpha_phy  <- get_alpha(ps_phylum)
means_phy  <- summarise_alpha(alpha_phy)

# plots
p1 <- plot_alpha(means_asv, "mean_shannon", "sd_shannon", "Shannon diversity (ASV)")
p2 <- plot_alpha(means_asv, "mean_pielou",  "sd_pielou",  "Pielou evenness (ASV)")
p3 <- plot_alpha(means_phy, "mean_shannon", "sd_shannon", "Shannon diversity (Phylum)")
p4 <- plot_alpha(means_phy, "mean_pielou",  "sd_pielou",  "Pielou evenness (Phylum)")

# combine into a 2x2 panel
ggarrange(p1, p2, p3, p4, ncol = 2, nrow = 2,
          labels = c("A", "B", "C", "D"))

# ggsave("plots/richness_supplement.pdf", width = 15, height = 15, units = "cm")
```

# sensitivity test of beta measures
```{r, eval = F}
# drop BBR to balance the design (only sites present at all layers)
ps_bal <- subset_samples(ps, code != "BBR")

# loop over layers: PERMANOVA, mean between-site distance, beta-dispersion
layers <- unique(metadata$layer)
results_list <- list()
for (cur_layer in layers) {
  # subset to current layer and drop empty taxa
  ps_sub <- subset_samples(ps_bal, layer == cur_layer)
  ps_sub <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(ps_sub) > 0, ps_sub)
  grouping <- sample_data(ps_sub)$code

  # weighted UniFrac distances and group statistics
  dist_mat <- phyloseq::distance(ps_sub, method = "wunifrac")
  perm <- vegan::adonis2(dist_mat ~ grouping)
  md   <- meandist(dist_mat, grouping)
  disp <- vegan::betadisper(dist_mat, grouping)
  disp_values <- disp$distances

  # store one row per site pair
  pair_names <- combn(rownames(md), 2, simplify = FALSE)
  for (p in pair_names) {
    pair_label <- paste(sort(p), collapse = " - ")
    results_list[[paste(cur_layer, pair_label)]] <- data.frame(
      label         = cur_layer,
      pair          = pair_label,
      R2            = perm[1, "R2"],
      Distance      = md[p[1], p[2]],
      Dispersion    = mean(disp_values),
      Dispersion_SE = sd(disp_values) / sqrt(length(disp_values))
    )
  }
}

# reshape to long format and label metrics
plot_data <- bind_rows(results_list) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols      = c(R2, Distance, Dispersion),
    names_to  = "metric_raw",
    values_to = "value"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    SE = case_when(
      metric_raw == "Dispersion" ~ Dispersion_SE,
      TRUE ~ 0
    ),
    metric_label = factor(case_match(metric_raw,
      "R2"         ~ "PERMANOVA R²",
      "Distance"   ~ "Between-Site Distance",
      "Dispersion" ~ "Beta-Dispersion"
    )),
    label = factor(label, levels = c("Ol0", "Ol1", "Olf", "Ohf", "Oh", "A5", "A10"))
  ) %>%
  subset(metric_raw != "Distance")

# plot: R2 and dispersion trends across layers
ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = label, y = value)) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = value - SE, ymax = value + SE),
    width = 0.1, linewidth = 0.3, color = "black",
    data = subset(plot_data, metric_raw == "Dispersion")
  ) +
  geom_line(
    aes(group = 1),
    color = "grey60", linewidth = 0.5
  ) +
  geom_point(size = 2, color = "black") +
  facet_wrap(~ metric_label, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(x = NULL) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 8) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x      = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, color = "black"),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black"),
    strip.text       = element_text(size = 7),
    axis.title.y     = element_blank()
  )

# ggsave("plots/final_figures/supplement_balanced_beta_per_layer.tiff", width = 7, height = 5, units = "cm", dpi = 400)
```
